{{Top|leg}}
'''Bailout Squadron''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] based at [[Kolaador Base]]. The squadron was composed entirely of test [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], who flew early versions of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] and the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
